data.name: Janan
data.gender_notes: Janan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who brings life or soul. The name Janan carries the meaning “Life, Soul” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Janan usually hope their child will grow to embody life, soul and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the breath of life, representing the soul and the connection to the divine
data.etymology: Janan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life, Soul.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Janan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: جنان
in_arabic.meaning: جنان تعني الجنة أو الحديقة الخضراء
in_arabic.long_meaning: جنان اسم علم مؤنث و معناه الجنة أو الحديقة الخضراء، و هو مشتق من الجنة التي وعد الله بها المؤمنين في القرآن الكريم. الجنة هي أعلى مراتب الجنة و هي المأوى الذي ينتظره المسلمون.

in_urdu.name: جنان
in_urdu.meaning: جنان کا مطلب جنت یا سبز باغ ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: جنان ایک علم مؤنث ہے اور اس کا مطلب جنت یا سبز باغ ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنت سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا اللہ تعالی نے قرآن کریم میں وعدہ کیا ہے۔ جنت مسلمانوں کے لئے ایک اعلیٰ مقام ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जानन
in_hindi.meaning: जानन का अर्थ स्वर्ग या हरित उद्यान होता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: जानन एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है और इसका अर्थ स्वर्ग या हरित उद्यान होता है। यह नाम स्वर्ग से लिया गया है जिसका वादा अल्लाह ने कुरआन में किया है। स्वर्ग मुसलमानों के लिए एक उच्च स्थान है।

in_pashto.name: جنان
in_pashto.meaning: جنان معنی جنت یا شنهیده باغ
in_pashto.long_meaning: جنان یو نوم دی او معنی یې جنت یا شنهیده باغ دی. دا نوم د جنت څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې الله تعالی په قرآن کریم کې ورته وعده کړې ده. جنت د مسلمانانو لپاره لوړ مقام دی.

in_english.name: Janan
in_english.meaning: Paradise or green garden, a blissful and serene abode
in_english.long_meaning: Janan is a feminine given name that signifies 'paradise' or 'green garden'. Etymologically derived from the Arabic word 'jannah', it refers to the heavenly abode promised to believers in the Quran. Historically, the name Janan has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a serene and blissful existence. Spiritually, it represents a haven of peace and tranquility, reflecting the aspirational values of Muslims worldwide.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل جہان
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل جہان

data.cultural_impact: The name "Janan" holds great significance in Islamic culture, as it is the Arabic word for "womb" or "mother's lap," symbolizing the place where a child first comes to life and receives nourishment. In Islamic societies, mothers hold a special place in the family and in the community, and the name "Janan" can be seen as a celebration of the nurturing and life-giving role of women.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Janan" can be understood as a reminder of the concept of divine creation in Islam. The Quran, the holy text of Islam, states that "Allah is the One who gives life and causes death, and you have no control over this matter" (Surah al-Hadid, 57:2). The name "Janan" can be a powerful reminder of the role of Allah as the Giver of Life and the Creator of all things. Ultimately, the name "Janan" reflects the deep connection between the physical world, the role of women in the rearing of children, and the spiritual reality of life and creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Life, Soul" symbolizes The one who brings life or soul. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Janan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of life, soul.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Born in Mecca, Janan was the daughter of Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) uncle, Abu Lahab. She was known for her deep faith and devotion to Islam despite her father's disbelief.
